title: Payload-free audit, opt-in bounded trace
goal: State and enforce what is recorded at which fidelity: the audit tier durable, signed and payload-free; the trace tier levelled, opt-in per subsystem, rotated and TTL'd under a measured bytes-per-day budget. Prove it with canaries - a secret, a prompt and a tool output must not reach the audit tier - and make trace redaction structural (types that cannot print a secret) rather than a filter someone must remember to apply.
